candidates.summary: Index() ships with no test at all: plan_test.go exercises Comment five times and never calls Index
candidates.failure_scenario: Index's heading prints len(p.Realms) while its rows are filtered by `if _, ok := c.pages[u]; !ok { continue }`, so a plan whose realms were not all crawled (page cap, per-file budget, a non-200 realm) renders '5 realm(s) rendered' over 3 links; no test builds a Crawler with a missing page, so neither that mismatch nor the raw-key lookup at line 170 is pinned, and the published index.html is the artifact a reviewer lands on first.

candidates.summary: the mixed branch's sentence and homepage link promise a gnoweb sample that this branch can never carry when a realm changed
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR touching gnoweb and a realm takes the default branch with p.Gnoweb true; main.go fills plan.Shots only in the `else if plan.Gnoweb` arm (main.go:147-151), so with len(ChangedRealms) > 0 Shots is nil, shotGrid at line 53 emits nothing, and the reader gets 'This PR changes **gnoweb** and realm sources.' plus a bare homepage link with no gnoweb page rendered anywhere in the comment. plan_test.go:257 asserts that absence, so the sentence, not the render, is what is wrong.
candidates.verify_by: sed -n '146,152p' misc/gnopreview/main.go shows Screenshot() under `else if plan.Gnoweb`; TestCommentBeforeAfter (plan_test.go:234-258) asserts the comment carries no 'Home — rendered markdown'
candidates.evidence: main.go:147-151 `if len(plan.ChangedRealms) > 0 { ... plan.Pairs = ScreenshotPairs(...) } else if plan.Gnoweb { plan.Shots = Screenshot(...) }`

candidates.summary: realms pulled in by a changed realm are filed under 'affected through a changed package', and that is exactly the case where the `_changed:` provenance line is dropped
candidates.failure_scenario: BuildPlan seeds dependents() with changedPkgs, which holds changed realms as well as changed p/ packages (plan.go:229-237, 239-246), so a realm importing a changed realm lands in `indirect`. With only realms changed, ChangedPkgs is empty: the header still reads 'Realms affected through a changed package (N)' and the `if len(p.ChangedPkgs) > 0` guard at line 76 drops the one line that would have named what pulled them in, leaving the reviewer no way to tell which change reaches those realms.
candidates.verify_by: read plan.go:229-246 (changedPkgs carries realms; dependents() walks the reverse import graph from it) and comment.go:75-78; build Plan{ChangedRealms:{gno.land/r/x/a}, ChangedPkgs:{}, Realms:{gno.land/r/x/a, gno.land/r/x/b}} and read the emitted header
candidates.evidence: plan.go:231 `plan.ChangedRealms = append(...)` and plan.go:240 `for _, p := range dependents(pkgs, changedPkgs)` share the same changedPkgs set; TestCommentRealms always passes a non-empty ChangedPkgs, so the case is unexercised

candidates.summary: Index indexes c.pages with a raw key while every other read of that map goes through canonicalURL
candidates.failure_scenario: crawl.go:339 (FileOf) and crawl.go:402 both look pages up as c.pages[canonicalURL(u)]; comment.go:170 uses c.pages[urlOf(r)] directly. It agrees today only because a realm root carries no `:args` and no `$query`; the one caller whose miss silently deletes a row from the published index is the one that skipped the accessor, so a later realm URL carrying either form drops out of index.html with no message while the heading keeps counting it.
candidates.verify_by: grep -n 'c.pages\[' misc/gnopreview/crawl.go misc/gnopreview/comment.go -> crawl.go:339,402 canonicalize, comment.go:170 does not; canonicalURL (crawl.go:287-298) re-joins :args and sorts $query parts
candidates.evidence: crawl.go:339 `p, ok := c.pages[canonicalURL(u)]` vs comment.go:170 `if _, ok := c.pages[u]; !ok`
